objective: Increase 0-3s retention and create first meaningful share/comment/save signals while keeping the five-slot funnel.
rules: No legacy 1.12 voice file for 06:45; regenerate using approved 06:45_warning profile.
Reach videos default to 6-9 seconds and max 3 primary scenes.
Hook must be understandable in <=0.5s without audio.
Payoff/proof by second 4 on reach slots and by second 5 on demo.
Prefer founder/social-native feel over polished corporate slideshow.
Do not call anything viral from views alone.

06:45.hypothesis: A sharper loss hook plus the approved natural warning voice will improve early retention versus recent pain-slot baseline.

10:00.hypothesis: An immediately usable prompt/template shown on screen will improve saves/shares relative to explanatory tips.

13:15.hypothesis: A visible before/after process demo will outperform narrated explanation on understanding and watchtime.

17:00.hypothesis: A concrete disagreeable claim plus direct question will increase comments/shares.

20:30.hypothesis: A shorter problem-to-offer bridge will improve conversion intent without optimizing for reach.

decision_rule: Compare each slot against its own recent platform baseline after comparable data accumulates. Change only 1-2 creative variables per iteration.
